headline: 2015 executive order aims to improve how federal agencies coordinate their work on Arctic issues.
what_it_does: This executive order is meant to improve coordination of the national government's efforts in the Arctic. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires, such as any new committees or duties, cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on Arctic matters
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to coordinate their Arctic-related work more closely with one another.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 21, 2015; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
